title: No PH-US signing of agreement on Pax Silica during ASEAN Summit- DTI official
summary: The Philippines and the United States are not scheduled to sign an agreement on the proposed Pax Silica Artificial Intelligence industrial hub at the upcoming ASEAN Summit, a DTI official said.
